title: Buffer before client commit
content: A provider stream must not become a client stream incrementally before terminal validation. An isolated V3 change demonstrated that routing provider failures through the typed Error chain and committing only a fully buffered successful attempt prevents failed-provider frames and errors from leaking into the client response; current production coverage must still be verified after integration with latest main.

title: Do not conflate two relay concepts
content: Direct/Relay is the protocol execution-mode decision. The provider transport relay and full-attempt return buffer are shared runtime boundaries used after that decision. Treating the transport bridge as proof that a Direct request entered Relay Chat Process creates duplicate rewrite ownership and an incorrect call graph.

title: Record contract and implementation separately
content: When user-confirmed architecture conflicts with an anchored map or current source, update the contract owner and record the implementation as needs-remediation. Do not store the desired contract as an already verified runtime fact, and do not delete every occurrence of a retired version token because protocol-version names may have different ownership.
